settings.headline: Enter your
settings.subtitle: One form per entry. You can enter as many works as you like, in any category, until its deadline.

settings.headline: Tell us about the work
settings.intro: All fields are required unless marked optional. We never publish your email.
settings.aside:
• Have a link to your work ready. A portfolio page or shared folder is fine.
  • Check the category deadlines.
  • Fees are paid after we confirm your entry, never on this site.
  • Students enter for free with a student email.

steps.title: We confirm by email
steps.text: Within two working days, with a link to change your entry.

steps.title: The jury scores
steps.text: Each judge scores on their own, then the panel meets in February.

steps.title: Shortlist on 12 March
steps.text: Shortlisted entrants hear first, by email, before it is public.
